verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Drive connectors let Claude search and send emails, manage your calendar, and work with documents inside the conversation, and that this connector data is not used for training. Other providers can be added through the connector directory or custom remote MCP servers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connector search quality, and explicit first-party connectors for non-Google drive, email, or calendar providers (these are only implied via the directory and custom MCP).
